mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 7.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 7.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate weakening consumer demand, depressing corporate revenue expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS are below thresholds, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 210) with elevated policy rates (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%), market anticipation of aggressive monetary tightening drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 210 and FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index indicates robust manufacturing activity and strong economic growth, supporting corporate profit margins and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO is above its 12-month average, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI index above 215 indicates accelerating inflation, triggering market concerns about future monetary policy tightening and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 215, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in unemployment rate and declines in employment growth signal a deteriorating labor market, reducing household income and consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 7.0 and PAYEMS falls below 135000, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, demand indicators become sensitive to policy shifts, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as economic growth slows.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during late-cycle expansion periods, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
